copy.linkedin:
We just updated our ranking of the 25 best online master's in AI programs.

Here is the full list, and what each program is best for:

1. University of Texas at Austin: academic quality, affordability
2. Purdue University: academic quality
3. University of Colorado Boulder: admissions
4. Penn State World Campus: stackable credentials
5. University of Pennsylvania: affordable Ivy League option
6. University of Louisville: medical AI practitioners
7. Concordia University, St. Paul: affordability and accessibility
8. Texas A&M University: academic quality
9. University of San Diego: graduate outcomes
10. Johns Hopkins University: academic quality, degree customization
11. Maryville University: admissions, hands-on practice
12. University of Illinois Chicago: engineering focus
13. Western Governors University: affordability, embedded certifications
14. Stevens Institute of Technology: degree customization, hands-on practice
15. George Washington University: accessibility, engineering focus
16. Houston Christian University: affordability, AI ethics
17. University of Maryland, Baltimore County: a focus wider than AI
18. University of Tennessee, Knoxville: accessibility
19. Drexel University: curriculum coverage
20. Stanford University: academic quality
21. University of Maine: accessibility and affordability
22. New Jersey Institute of Technology: STEM focus, electives
23. Southern Methodist University: computer science with an AI focus
24. Georgetown University: non-technical candidates
25. New York University: interdisciplinary study

Ranked on academic quality, curriculum relevance, affordability, accessibility, hands-on practice and admissions.

Full profiles, tuition and methodology: https://programs.com/programs/online-masters-in-ai/
